details:
service: DataStoreService
runs: at module load, on the server and on every client
message: src/shared/save.ts reads the server-only service DataStoreService when it loads, and shared modules load on the client too.
name: shared-server-service-at-load
suggestion: Move the DataStoreService access into a server module (server/, actions.ts, runtime.ts) and pass shared code the data it needs, or read it inside a function behind RunService.IsServer().

details:
service: MemoryStoreService
runs: whenever the enclosing function is called, on whichever side calls it
message: src/shared/save.ts reads the server-only service MemoryStoreService from shared code with no RunService.IsServer() guard.
name: shared-server-service-access
suggestion: Move the function into a server module, or guard the MemoryStoreService access with `if (RunService.IsServer())` (an early `if (RunService.IsClient()) return;` counts too).

details:
importer: src/domains/economy/model.ts
importer kind: shared
imported: src/domains/economy/server/store.ts
imported kind: server
message: src/domains/economy/model.ts is classified as shared. It imports src/domains/economy/server/store.ts, which is classified as server.
name: shared-imports-server
suggestion: Keep shared modules free of server-only imports, or split server code into server/.

message: src/domains/combat/model.ts is shared, but loading it loads the server module src/domains/economy/server/store.ts through src/domains/economy/model.ts, so it cannot load on the client.
name: shared-transitive-server-dependency
suggestion: The import to fix is in src/domains/economy/model.ts. Move the runtime dependency into a server module, import only the type it needs (`import type`), or pass the value in from a server entry.
